name: convertkoro-site
description: Static site + Netlify Functions for convertkoro.com. @netlify/blobs is required for the URL Shortener's server-backed short links (shorten.js, redirect.js), the server-side video/media pipeline (video-*.js, media-*.js), and AI model storage (ai-models store, holding the large LaMa inpainting model too big to bundle directly - see setup-inpaint-model-background.js). ffmpeg-static provides a real, statically-linked ffmpeg binary for genuine server-side video compression. onnxruntime-node and sharp power the real server-side AI pipelines: remove-background.js (U2-Net, bundled at netlify/functions/models/u2netp.onnx, ~4.7MB) and remove-object.js (LaMa, ~208MB, fetched from Blobs at runtime rather than bundled). See netlify.toml's [build.environment] for why onnxruntime-node's CUDA download must be explicitly skipped at install time.
